Frequently asked questions

Can I switch between monthly and annual billing?

Yes. Switching to annual billing applies the discount from your next renewal. Annual plans are billed upfront for 12 months.

Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?

Registered nonprofits get 50% off Starter and Pro. Contact us with your registration details.

What happens when my trial ends?

After 14 days your workspace becomes read-only until you choose a plan. Nothing is deleted.
